    Kia Manawaroa Matariki special

    Welcome to the Matariki special of Kia Manawaroa, our monthly newsletter for whānau Māori.

    Last updated: 23 July 2026
    1 min to read
    On this page
    • What Kia Manawaroa is
    • Questions, feedback and story ideas

    This issue includes information and stories about Te Mātahi o te Tau | the Māori New Year including:

    • Matariki herenga waka – for everyone
    • The Year of Ruhanui
    • reflecting, connecting and looking forward with hope.

    Read the Matariki special:

    Kia Manawaroa – July 2026

    What Kia Manawaroa is#

    Kia Manawaroa is our pānui for whānau Māori. It keeps you updated on milestones, changes and opportunities in education. The newsletter goes out monthly during school terms, and it’s free to subscribe.

    Subscribe to Kia Manawaroa – Mailchimp

    Questions, feedback and story ideas#

    For questions, feedback or story ideas, email us – we’d love to hear from you!
